introHtml: 20 stem phone wallets combine a secure card holder with a built-in stand that holds your phone at the perfect viewing angle. This design is ideal for trade show staff who need hands-free video calls or safety managers wanting quick access to ID badges. The 20 stem style provides a stable grip and works with most phone cases. Choose from materials like silicone or leather, and add your logo through screen printing or debossing for a professional look.
